definitions: An old method, technology, computer system, or application program, 'of or relating to a previous or outdated computer system, software, or the like'
A computer system or application program which continues to be used because of the cost of replacing it, despite its poor performance or incompatibility with modern equivalents.
examples: The company still relies on a legacy system for its payroll.
Upgrading the legacy system is a major project.
Many organizations struggle with maintaining their legacy systems.
